parameters.query:
WITH target AS (
  SELECT mission_id, autofix_attempts
  FROM gov.missions
  WHERE mission_id = '{{$json.mission_id_sql}}'
), upd AS (
  UPDATE gov.missions m
  SET
    autofix_attempts = CASE WHEN t.autofix_attempts < 2 THEN t.autofix_attempts + 1 ELSE t.autofix_attempts END,
    autofix_state = CASE
      WHEN t.autofix_attempts = 0 THEN 'round_1'
      WHEN t.autofix_attempts = 1 THEN 'round_2'
      ELSE 'paused_waiting_owner'
    END,
    autofix_last_error_code = '{{$json.error_code_sql}}',
    autofix_last_error_excerpt_256 = LEFT('{{$json.error_excerpt_sql}}', 256),
    owner_call_required = CASE WHEN t.autofix_attempts >= 2 THEN true ELSE false END,
    paused_reason = CASE WHEN t.autofix_attempts >= 2 THEN 'AUTO_FIX_LIMIT_EXCEEDED' ELSE paused_reason END
  FROM target t
  WHERE m.mission_id = t.mission_id
  RETURNING m.mission_id, m.autofix_attempts, m.autofix_state, m.owner_call_required
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM upd) THEN true ELSE false END AS found,
  COALESCE((SELECT mission_id FROM upd), '') AS mission_id,
  COALESCE((SELECT autofix_attempts FROM upd), -1) AS autofix_attempts,
  COALESCE((SELECT autofix_state FROM upd), 'not_found') AS autofix_state,
  COALESCE((SELECT owner_call_required FROM upd), false) AS owner_call_required,
  CASE
    WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM upd) AND (SELECT autofix_state FROM upd) = 'paused_waiting_owner' THEN 'pause_owner'
    WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM upd) THEN 'retry_limited'
    ELSE 'mission_not_found'
  END AS next_action;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { status: 'ok', mission_id: $json.mission_id, req_mission_id: $node['Validar Autofix Limitado'].json.mission_id, autofix_attempts: Number($json.autofix_attempts || 0), autofix_state: $json.autofix_state, owner_call_required: !!$json.owner_call_required, next_action: $json.next_action } }}
